description: Read one inference allowance opt-in by its id: open, exhausted, closed or expired, the NET it names, the cap, what is allocated and what is counted, in inference units. With no id, the program page: its caps, its unit and the routes written as prepared steps, each with its source, the day it was read and what was NOT READ. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. It shows no wallet, no payee and no payment reference, and there is no list by wallet. It says plainly that the NET is not held and that Vealth holds no VVV, DIEM or USDC and is never the payee. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

optInId.description: The opt-in's id (the optInId it was opened under). Leave it out to read the program and its routes.
